notes.title: Additional Game Settings
notes.content:
In this small update, we've added two additional gameplay settings.

[list]
[*] [b]KO Slow-Mo Setting[/b]: You can now choose how much the game slows down when a player is knocked out. Set it to Off, Light, or Heavy depending on your preference.
[*] [b]Round Wins Needed Setting[/b]: Change how many rounds a player must win to take the match. You can now choose between quick games or longer battles with friends.
[/list]

notes.title: Shaolin Bao Launches April 17th! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey folks!

Get ready as Shaolin Bao officially launches on April 17th at 10am PDT, just 10 days away! 🎉

Here's what you'll get on launch day:
🎮 Local multiplayer with support for online play via Steam Remote Play
⛩️ 21 unique maps packed with dynamic surprises
🥟 12 deliciously cute dim sum characters to play as
⚡ 9 wild powerups to keep your battles spicy
🤖 AI Bots for solo or party practice
🎵 An original soundtrack to jam out to while you battle
🏆 27 Steam achievements to collect

Expect 5 more maps and 12 additional achievements to be added in an update post-launch!

We also wanted to give a huge shoutout to everyone who played the demo - your feedback helped us find and fix bugs, add of quality-of-life improvements, and focus efforts to majorly improve our AI bots.

We look forward to you all picking up Shaolin Bao on launch, we can't wait to see you battling it out!

See you in-game,
Nick & the Shaolin Bao Team

notes.title: Demo Update 2.0: 10 New Arenas, New Powerups, & An Original Sountrack 🙌
notes.content:
Get ready to experience Shaolin Bao like never before – we’ve packed this major update with a whole host of new features, wild arenas, and fresh music to keep the action sizzling!

[h2]🔥 10 Brand New Arenas![/h2]

Step into a dozen new battlegrounds (okay, 10 arenas, but they’re awesome!) where every map challenges you with its own twist. Here’s just a sneak peek of what’s waiting for you, but to truly feel the chaos, grab some friends and jump into the demo:
[list]
[*] [b]Giant, Smashing Stone Hands[/b] poised to crush the unprepared – can you slip through in time?
[*] [b]Spike Trap Mazes[/b] reworking the flow of movement, forcing you to rethink your path to survive!
[/list]Ready to prove your skills? Play the demo and discover even more surprises on the battlefield!

[h2]⚡ Powerup Extravaganza![/h2]

Amp up your gameplay with a slew of new powerups, exciting tweaks to fan favorites, and yes—we’ve removed a few that didn’t quite make the cut. Here's a little teaser of what's in store:
[list]
[*] [b]Earth Shield[/b]: Encase yourself in a ring of rock-solid shields, perfect for shrugging off enemy attacks.
[*] [b]Ice Ring[/b]: Unleash a burst of icy energy, freezing foes in their tracks and shifting the tide of battle.
[*] [b]Mushroom Ring[/b]: Turn your foes into  adorable, peaceful mushrooms, making them lose their ability to attack… but just for a bit.
[/list]Curious about the rest? Jump into the demo with your friends to discover all the new powerups waiting to spice up your battles!

[h2]🎶 Expanded Original Soundtrack[/h2]

Jam out to our enhanced Shaolin Bao soundtrack featuring all-new arrangements and beats that perfectly complement the high-energy chaos on screen.

Huge shout-out to the incredibly talented [url=https://youtube.com/@je_suis_le_homard?si=ZeQnvOreTiLiE3OY]Howard Chi[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/joyangmusic/]Joshua Yang[/url], for these incredible tracks!

The beats are so good, you might just find yourself lingering in-game, not to battle, but to vibe. They're that catchy!

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes & Quality Improvements[/h2]

We’ve been hard at work squashing bugs and polishing up the game. Your experience should be a lot smoother with this update!

[h2]💬 Wishlist us on Steam![/h2]
We’re excited for you to dive into these new features and see how they spice up the battlefield. As always, your feedback is the secret ingredient that makes Shaolin Bao even better, we're excited to hear from you!

🍜 Happy gaming!
Nick & the Shaolin Bao Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348740/Shaolin_Bao_Demo/

notes.title: Play the Shaolin Bao Demo Today!
notes.content:
Hi friends!

The Shaolin Bao Demo is now available for any and all to play! Get ready to dash, slice, and battle your way through chaotic, fast-paced matches in local multiplayer Shaolin Bao demo.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348740/Shaolin_Bao_Demo/

[h2]What’s in the Demo?[/h2]
🎭 Local Multiplayer Fun: Gather your friends for some couch PvP chaos.
🌟 5 Arenas: Dive into 5 beautifully designed Chinese-inspired arenas that challenge your skills.
🥟 Playable Bao Characters: Pick from a lineup of adorable, fierce dim sum warriors.

[h2]How to Play[/h2]
☝️ Check out the Shaolin Bao Demo link above
☝️ Download the Demo and jump right into the action!

[h2]Play Online With Friends[/h2]
Play online with your friends via [u][b]Steam Remote Play[/b][/u]!
1. Launch the Shaolin Bao Beta
2. Open your Steam Overlay in-game (Shift+Tab)
3. Select 'Remote Play Together' and invite your friends

We’ve been pouring our hearts into crafting a demo that’s as deliciously fun as your favorite dim sum, and today we’re thrilled to let you take your first bite. Whether you’re a button-mashing bao master or a precise fan-throwing expert, this demo will give you a taste of what’s to come.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us! We want to hear what you love, what could be better, and any ideas you have to make Shaolin Bao even more fun. Join the conversation on our Steam Community Hub or leave a review on the Demo page.

Thanks for supporting us and helping us bring this dream to life.

🥢 Stay hungry,
Nick & the Shaolin Bao Team

P.S. If you enjoy the demo, don’t forget to add Shaolin Bao to your wishlist – it really helps us out! 💖
